doc: Scoring test vectors. input = ScoringInput (see scoring_rules.json doc). expect.fired = rule ids in red_flag order. expect.brand_matches = report.brand.matches (null when brand not in brand_domains). Optional: headline_en, flags[] (checked by rule_id: source, severity, evidence, title_en, title_ko).

case_* vectors: features built from redflag-gemma-test/cases*.jsonl `expected` (first allowed value; missing booleans -> false; claimed_brand = the brand's common name). Expected scores were computed BY HAND from Appendix B weights, then cross-checked against the Python implementation.

v2 (2026-11-04): expectations re-derived BY HAND from v1 + the v2 rule changes (brand_mismatch_sensitive_request +20, secret_code_requested 25, clamp rules). ScoringInput may carry features_repaired / analysis_incomplete (default false).

v3 (2026-11-04): repaired vectors re-derived by hand for the corrected/narrowed D2 (lower bound only, only if a core field was repaired or a deterministic signal is not clean); hidden_text pattern vectors added. signals.hidden_text is optional.

v4 (2026-11-04): data-destination (signals.data_endpoints, form_destination) and context (input.context) vectors. Expectations derived BY HAND from the v4 rules; the *_no_fire / cannot_lower vectors pin that context and Gemma answers only add.
